254: To make it capable enough, an easy method is to expand the dimension of embedding vector, which unfortunately will increase the size of learning parameters heavily.

Retained the incumbent at validation AUC **0.61498885**. History-mean scaling did not improve it; scale reassignment performed worse. Mechanism conclusions remain provisional and single-seed.

No training or withheld evaluation was run.
